messages.author: 63614f6cb574b5fe
messages.subject: Re: gridExtra::arrangeGrob exits with Error: nrow * ncol >= n is not TRUE
parts:
You are right,
I just noticed that I copy pasted incorrect R code. Here is the one which worked before gridExtra update in July 2015 and does not work any more:
########

gridExtra::arrangeGrob(g1, g1, ncol=2, nrow=1, main="TITLE")
########
It exits with
Error: nrow * ncol >= n is not TRUE

However just changing the old parameter main to the new top fixes the issue.

Sorry for inconvenience. and thank you for your time and help!
 /Marek
